EqualAmount.name: Equal Amount
EqualAmount.definition: Exact value an amount must match to be considered valid.

NotEqualAmount.name: Not Equal Amount
NotEqualAmount.definition: Value that an amount must not match to be considered valid.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the amount is a credited or debited amount.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Medium of exchange of value, used to qualify an amount.

FromAmount.name: From Amount
FromAmount.definition: Lower boundary of a range of amount values.

ToAmount.name: To Amount
ToAmount.definition: Upper boundary of a range of amount values.

RelatedInterest.name: Related Interest
RelatedInterest.definition: Interest which applies on a specific amount range.
